newSources.title: Albany — Middleton Beach
newSources.story: Look east across Middleton Beach from the Albany Surf Life Saving Club camera. The reviewed still shows sand, shore break, blue water and the opposite shoreline, partly framed by the building. Open the official camera page and check its capture clock; the visible scene does not establish swimming safety, patrol service, water quality or conditions elsewhere in Albany. The archive contains older images and is not continuous live video.

newSources.story: See the Mandurah Ocean Marina entrance, breakwaters and ocean from the Marine Operation Centre roof camera. The reviewed still shows the entrance, nearby road and parking area under clear sky; it does not cover every berth or the inland canals. Inspect the official capture clock and check marine notices, tides and weather separately. A camera image does not establish navigation safety, berth access, cruise operation or dolphin sightings.
